description: Agent Travel: submit the fare rules attached to a ticket as purchased with what the buyer was told: the fare rules with the fare class, fare basis, currency, whether the ticket is refundable and the refund fee, whether changes are allowed and the change fee, the checked bags and carry-on included, seat selection (included, at extra cost or none), each restriction as filed and the rules as filed; and what the buyer was told, with where (the booking page, a message or a quote), when, the fare class, currency, the same refund, change, baggage and seat terms, the restrictions named and the text, read for wording such as fully refundable, free changes or bags included. The signed report gives the fare rules, what was told, every term point by point with the rules beside the telling, whether they match and whether the buyer was told more or less than the rules give, every restriction with whether the buyer was told of it, and the promising wording found with what the rules contradict, and counts them, and names a misstated fare: a ticket told as refundable that is not, a refund or change fee told lower than the rules, changes told as allowed where the rules allow none, baggage told as included beyond the rules and wording that promises flexibility or bags the rules contradict; then another fare class, seat selection told more favorably, a restriction never told, terms told more strictly than the rules and fees told in another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Nothing told, no refundability, no change fee or no baggage allowance in the rules leaves the fare unverified. This reads one ticket’s fare rules against what the buyer was told: a purchase’s price, scope and cancellation against governing terms is wever_terms-match-check, a quote against a vendor’s terms is wever_vendor-terms-match-check and a quoted amount against the settled charge is wever_price-truth-check. Verdict travel_fare_misstated, travel_fare_partial, travel_fare_unverified or travel_fare_as_stated. POST /api/travel-fare-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.
